compiled_state.title: S6.T3: Wire claude-safe to source worktree-removal-guards.sh + assert_worktree_removable
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: claude-safe refuses worktree removal when ANY guard fires.
- DD3: --force bypass prints firing guard + PR URL.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe` (NOT agent-batch-lifecycle.sh \xe2\x80\x94 the story description has this wrong; verify via 'ls plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe'):

1. Source the new library at the top:
   ```bash
   # shellcheck source=plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh
   source "\${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-\${REPO_ROOT}/plugins/dso}/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh"
   ```
2. In `_offer_worktree_cleanup` (around line 160 area where `git worktree remove` is called):
   - BEFORE any side-effecting work: call `assert_worktree_removable "\$_WT_PATH" "\$_WT_BRANCH" [\$FORCE_FLAG]` and exit early on refusal.
   - IMMEDIATELY before `git worktree remove`: call again (TOCTOU re-check). This second call is load-bearing.
3. Update `--force` handling: pass `--force` through to `assert_worktree_removable` so guards still RUN but exit code is 0 (per DD#3 behavior).
4. Update existing tests (`tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-*.sh`) to assert refusal behavior when guards fire.

After implementation: existing claude-safe tests must still pass + new assertions added.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe` | modify | `tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-*.sh` (existing) | needs-modification |
| `tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-guards.sh` | create | (new test for guard integration) | needs-creation |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] claude-safe sources the guards library
  Verify: grep -q 'worktree-removal-guards.sh' plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe
- [ ] assert_worktree_removable called BEFORE git worktree remove
  Verify: grep -A 5 'git worktree remove' plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe | grep -q 'assert_worktree_removable'
- [ ] TOCTOU re-check: assert_worktree_removable called TWICE in _offer_worktree_cleanup
  Verify: grep -c 'assert_worktree_removable' plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe | awk '{exit (\$1>=2?0:1)}'
- [ ] Existing claude-safe tests still pass
  Verify: for t in tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-*.sh; do bash "\$t" || exit 1; done

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.

comments.body:
AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F3 + gap-analysis #3, #6):

**TOCTOU rationale (plan-review F3 major)**:
- Add inline code comment at the second assert_worktree_removable call in claude-safe explaining: 'TOCTOU window mitigation: claude-safe runs an interactive Claude session between worktree creation and removal; state (PRs, uncommitted changes) can change during the session. Re-check immediately before git worktree remove narrows the window. This pattern is asymmetric with harvest-worktree.sh (single-check) — see plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh for the batched-fast-path rationale.'

**Concurrent claude-safe lock (gap-analysis #6 race condition)**:
- Wrap the guard-recheck + git-worktree-remove sequence in 'flock -n <lockfile>'. Lockfile path: <worktree-parent>/.claude-safe-<basename>.lock OR if worktree itself is being removed, use a sibling-lock at <worktree-parent>/.claude-safe.<basename>.lock.
- On flock acquisition failure: print 'another claude-safe operation in progress on $worktree_path' and exit non-zero (do NOT proceed).
- Add unit test: spawn two claude-safe processes on the same worktree; assert exactly one succeeds and the other prints the lock-busy message.

Additional AC items:
- [ ] TOCTOU rationale comment present in claude-safe
  Verify: grep -A 2 'TOCTOU' plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe | grep -q 'interactive Claude session'
- [ ] Concurrent-claude-safe lock implemented via flock -n
  Verify: grep -qE 'flock -n|flock --nonblock' plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe
